descricao_original: Three regions of the nucleolus are visible in this electron micrograph. The pale areas are the nucleolar organizing centers. The most dense areas are the pars fibrosa, which contain newly synthesized primary transcripts of RNA genes. The pars granulosa has a granular appearance and contains maturing ribosomal particles. 30,000x
